nextcook.description: Orders, kitchen, cashier, stock and reports in one system. I built the architecture, database and front end from scratch. A company project, so the code is private.

folio.name: Folio
folio.description: An e-commerce site for world classics in a "museum hall" design: 60 books, 45 authors, a 3D book, cart and checkout.

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.description: Live weather for Azerbaijan: a sky that changes with the weather, hourly charts, air quality, moon phases. Installs on a phone like an app and opens offline.

reelbook.description: A diary for the movies and series you watch: ratings, reviews, episode tracking, new-episode reminders and yearly stats. Android, iOS and the web from one codebase.
